subject.title: fix(ai): bound openai-chatgpt-responses WebSocket with handshakeTimeout and maxPayload

question: Must this fix provide a transport-level inbound payload cap where the runtime supports one, or is a post-delivery 16 MiB decode/parse cap an acceptable cross-runtime guarantee?
rationale: Browser-compatible WebSocket APIs do not expose a portable max-payload option, while the current application-level check runs only after a complete message has been delivered; the acceptable resource-exhaustion boundary therefore requires owner judgment.

options.title: Require layered enforcement
options.body: Use runtime transport limits where supported, retain the portable application-level fallback, and document or test the remaining browser/Bun guarantee.

options.title: Accept parser-only enforcement
options.body: Treat 16 MiB as a decode/JSON-processing bound rather than an OOM-proof wire limit and narrow the PR claims and tests accordingly.

recommendation.title: Require layered enforcement
recommendation.body: Use runtime transport limits where supported, retain the portable application-level fallback, and document or test the remaining browser/Bun guarantee.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history introduced the affected native WebSocket lifecycle and fallback behavior.
